name: Wichterle Château
built_label: Baroque château, c. 1750, on the site of a medieval fortified manor; rebuilt 1846–1847; reopened 2019
architectural_style: A three-wing Baroque château dated to around 1750, raised on the site of a fortified manor probably dating from the mid-14th century, rebuilt again in 1846–1847 with lowered roofs, terraces and an ornamental gable facing the park
accessibility: A restored Baroque château operating as a hotel with a beer spa; contact the hotel directly regarding specific accessibility requirements.
tagline: A Baroque château on the site of a medieval fortified manor in the centre of Slavičín, owned by the Wichterle family from 1912 and reopened in 2019 as a hotel with a beer spa in its cellars and an English park
highlights: The Bishop of Olomouc granted the Slavičín region as a fief in 1256, and the hotel's history page says a fortified manor probably stood on the château site from around the middle of the 14th century; archaeological finds from 1978 in the courtyard point to timber buildings of the 14th and 15th centuries
After a fire in the second half of the 15th century a stone and brick manor replaced the earlier buildings, and it was altered several times in the 16th and 17th centuries
Before the middle of the 18th century the manor was radically rebuilt into a three-wing château, and the town's tourist office dates the Baroque building to around 1750
The château was rebuilt again in 1846–1847, when its roofs were lowered and terraces and an ornamental gable facing the park were added
In 1912 the estate passed to Lambert and Josefa Wichterle, whose family kept it until the state confiscated it in 1948
It was returned to the heirs in 1992, restored from 2018 and reopened on 6 December 2019 as a hotel with a beer spa in its cellars
description:
A fortified manor probably stood on this small rise in Slavičín from around the middle of the 14th century; the town was part of the Bishop of Olomouc's fief, granted in 1256. After a fire in the second half of the 15th century a stone manor replaced it, and before the middle of the 18th century it was radically rebuilt into a three-wing château; the town's tourist office dates the Baroque building to around 1750.

It was rebuilt again in 1846–1847, and in 1912 the estate passed to the Wichterle family, who kept it until the state confiscated it in 1948. In the communist era it housed a cinema, a restaurant and cultural clubs.

It was returned to the heirs in 1992, restored from 2018 and reopened in December 2019 as a hotel with a beer spa. Sources differ on its architectural style and on some dates.

faqs.question: Is Wichterle Château open for tours?
faqs.answer: No. The town's tourist office says the château offers no tour circuit for tourists; it operates as a hotel with a restaurant, a café and a beer spa.

faqs.question: What is the beer spa at the château?
faqs.answer: A spa in the château's deep cellars where guests bathe in wooden tubs; the hotel also offers wellness and sauna packages that can be booked on its website.

hotel.hotel_name: Zámek Wichterle – Hotel a pivní lázně
hotel.room_location_note: Rooms are in the château, Osvobození 24; ask the hotel which floor or wing your room is in
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In the centre of Slavičín on a small rise at Osvobození 24, in the Zlín Region; the hotel says visitor parking is in the lot in front of the château, and Booking lists free private parking.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €145/night for a Standard Double Room with a queen bed, a city view, air conditioning, a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV, a minibar and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast included and free cancellation until about two weeks before the stay seen; a Family Room with Bathroom and a Deluxe Family Room were the same price. Booking showed the price with taxes and fees included.

**On-site:** A restaurant and a café, a beer spa with baths in wooden tubs in the château's cellars, wellness and saunas, and an English park with a playground, a chestnut avenue and a summer terrace where pets are allowed.

**Good to know:** Rates were seen for one January 2027 stay, a low-season date, so check your own dates on Booking. The château offers no tour for tourists, according to the town's tourist office, but the restaurant, the café and the beer spa can be booked separately on the hotel's website. Sources differ on the château's style and on some dates.
